entries.camera: Side-on low close-up still life at ground level, 70mm, very shallow depth of field, a soft sunrise flare behind the blade.
entries.subject: A longsword planted point-down in a cracked flagstone at the centre of a roofless stone hall, radiant light running along the whole blade as if the steel itself were a sunrise. A gauntleted hand, cropped at the wrist, rests on the pommel, and a clean white tabard is folded over the crossguard. Golden motes drift upward from the steel and a flat ring of light lies on the floor around the point. Behind, the blurred broken arches of the hall and one pouring sunbeam.

entries.camera: Extreme wide high-angle shot from above the canopy looking down, the figure tiny, enormous depth.
entries.subject: A tiny armoured figure, seen from above and behind, stands with one hand raised before a colossal ancient tree in a forest clearing ringed by mossy standing stones. Glowing green veins run through the roots, and from the raised hand a protective spiral of leaves and blossom winds up around the trunk. Fireflies and drifting petals fill the air, wildflowers carpet the clearing, and at its edge a pale stag made of leaf-light stands still in the mist.
entries.accent: lush emerald green with dappled sunlit gold

entries.camera: Strongly backlit silhouette shot from low behind the figure, wide lens, the horizon low and the burning sky filling most of the frame.
entries.subject: A black-armoured figure, only a silhouette, stands on the broken wall of a ruined city at dusk. A huge pair of wings made of crimson fire and burning embers is unfurled behind it, lighting the smoke and drifting ash of the sky. From the raised hand a single narrow beam of red light falls across the empty street far below onto a toppled stone statue, splitting it down the middle. Charred beams and scattered embers lie around.

entries.camera: Straight-down overhead view, symmetrical, wide lens, the figure at the exact centre of the frame.
entries.subject: Looking straight down at a single towering figure in spiked black plate armour, seen only as a dark shape from above, standing at the centre of a churned battlefield with a heavy mace resting head-down at its feet. Around it in a perfect widening ring lie hundreds of dropped swords, spears and shields, pointing outward like rays. A slow ripple of dark pressure bends the trampled grass and smoke outward from the figure. Plain torn banners with no emblem lie among the weapons.
entries.accent: scorched earth brown and cold iron-grey

entries.camera: Symmetrical eye-level one-point-perspective view straight down a vast throne hall from behind the figure, ultra-wide lens, the empty throne at the vanishing point.
entries.subject: A kneeling knight in polished plate, seen from behind, a longsword planted point-down before them, at the near end of a vast empty throne hall: rows of tall pillars, long plain banners hanging slack, a deep carpet running to an empty stone throne. Above the empty seat a plain golden crown hovers inside a single shaft of sunlight, dust motes glittering in the beam. A tall shield on the knight's back is carved with a crown relief.

entries.camera: Canted (dutch-angle) freeze-frame at a high shutter speed from low and slightly behind the leap, wide lens.
entries.subject: An athletic armoured champion, seen from behind with the face turned away, frozen in a huge leap across a gap between two towers of a grand sunlit arena, a long cape of golden light streaming behind. Bright trails of speed ripple from the heels and shoulders, and a sword raised overhead throws a spray of sparks. Far below, the silhouetted crowd tosses flowers and laurel leaves into the air, hanging glittering in the light, with plain pennants snapping in the wind.
entries.accent: vivid sunlit cyan with sparkling white

entries.camera: Over-the-shoulder medium shot from just behind and to the left of the figure, 50mm, soft dawn backlight.
entries.subject: A plainly armoured figure in a closed helm, seen from behind, kneels on an abandoned battlefield at dawn and holds out one bare open hand, palm up, over a circle of laid-down weapons: swords, axes and spears planted point-down in the earth, each blade softly glowing and wrapped in fresh green shoots and small white wildflowers. A few dropped shields lie at the edges. Low mist drifts, and a single sapling grows in the centre of the ring.
entries.accent: soft dawn rose-pink and pale peach

entries.camera: Extreme macro close-up at hand height, 100mm, very shallow depth of field, the cracking medallion in sharp focus.
entries.subject: A black-gauntleted fist, cropped at the wrist, crushes a silver sunburst medallion. The medallion cracks open and the light inside leaks out, turning into black smoke and spectral violet flame that crawls up the knuckles. A snapped sword belt and a ribbon of white cloth, burnt at the edges, fall away from the hand. Behind, blurred, a dark crypt lined with carved stone knights and a single carved skull motif on the pauldron.
entries.accent: ash-black with sickly violet spectral flame

entries.camera: Low-angle ultra-wide view looking up from the stone floor of a watchtower parapet, the figure towering against the night sky.
entries.subject: A lone sentinel in dark plate armour, seen from behind and below as a silhouette on a high watchtower parapet at night, holds a large round shield raised. From the shield a vast dome of pale silver ward light spreads over the sleeping rooftops behind, concentric rings of non-legible glyph shapes drifting across its surface. Beyond the dome a rip in the night sky shows a swirling seam of alien geometry and ghostly tendrils that press against the light and slide off it.
entries.accent: cold moon-silver with deep midnight teal

entries.camera: Medium-long telephoto 135mm shot at eye level in golden-hour heat haze, the figure and the apparition compressed into one layered image.
entries.subject: A paladin in sand-coloured plate with brass filigree, seen from behind, stands in a ruined desert palace court at sunset holding a longsword upright. Around the blade a column of swirling sand and sparkling smoke rises into the enormous translucent, featureless silhouette of a genie behind the paladin, its arms of vapour curling protectively around. Embers, gold dust and heat ripples flicker through its body, and a small ornate brass lamp floats beside the blade trailing a thread of smoke.
entries.accent: burnished brass and saffron-orange with magenta dusk
